subject: Old Entity Hastorr
grounds: This card represents a very powerful tool full of utility unlike anything else in the format.

subject: Cross Debug
grounds: This card represents too much of an advantage in battles from the GY (even if niche where it can apply), practically walling out certain gamestates in a way that does not feel healthy to include in retro.

subject: Ally Salvo
grounds: This is a feast-or-famine card that does not feel good to play or play into. Punishing players this hard for playing a specific category of monsters (LIGHT) is not a healthy interaction to have in Retro.

subject: Thunder Dragon Fusion
grounds: Even in principle, a Fusion this generic that can fuse for free, and then (or even separately!) act as a searcher for an entire Type from GY is too much for Retro.

subject: Thunder Dragonduo
grounds: A 2800 (or 3100) ATK Chaos-like monster that can search another copy of itself, as well as act as recursion/deck fixing, is a bit over the top for the low investment it requires.

subject: Cards of Consonance
grounds: Even archetype-locked 'Trade-in'-like cards are historically very powerful in Retro (see Destiny Draw); a 'Trade-In' this generic is too powerful for Retro.

subject: Doublebyte Dragon
grounds: While it's difficult to pump Doublebyte Dragon to astronomical ATK values, being unaffected and battle immune to non-links makes this card very frustrating to play against.

subject: Nibiru, the Primal Being
grounds: While not as easy to trigger in Retro due to the slower pace of the format, the huge payoff and potential one-sided advantage it brings against Summon-heavy strategies make this a feast-or-famine card antithetical to the format's core philosophy

subject: Bingo Card
grounds: The prospective board wipes, even if they offer a draw-2 as compensation, are not a space we want to explore in Retro.

subject: Double or Nothing!
grounds: Utopia exists and makes this card hilariously broken.

subject: Geminize Lord Golknight
grounds: Gemini and Gigavise strategies do not need support this powerful in terms of consistency.
